name: feature.career-agent.agents
description: The career agent (ADR 0543) — a standing persona that finds roles, scores fit against a profile, checks eligibility against a JD-stated bar, and prepares applications. Ships NO execution loop: the heartbeat daemon + kanban board + ADR 0534 ranked selection + ADR 0535 recovery already are the loop. The persona is DATA — nothing about it lives in host source.
author: OpenWOP App

agents.label: Career agent
agents.description: Finds roles worth applying to, scores them against your profile, and prepares applications within the limits you set. Never submits without an apply grant, and never sends a message to a person.
